description: The objective of the purchase is to implement a live QKD network to validate various QKD topologies Ring, Star, Chain and learn about QKD implementation and performance. This purchase is required for the implementation of activities planned under LUQCIA project funded by SMC. The purchase will be fully covered by the project. The Equipment is a set of transmitters and receivers for the implementation of QKD. The purchase includes the necessary equipment for the implementation of three (3) QKD links. For each link, a transmitter and a receiver are required. The offer of IDQeach Cerberis XGR-P2P-1551-18 item is a transmitter and a receiver set.
